# xlsx_reader v0.8.12 - Table of Contents

> XLSX file reader for Elixir

## Pages

- [README](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [XlsxReader](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.md): 
Opens XLSX workbooks and reads its worksheets.
- [XlsxReader.Cell](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Cell.md): Cell structure.
- [XlsxReader.Conversion](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Conversion.md): 
Conversion of cell values to Elixir types.
- [XlsxReader.Package](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Package.md): 
XSLX Package structure.
- [XlsxReader.Sheet](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Sheet.md): 
Worksheet structure.
- [XlsxReader.Styles](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Styles.md): Utility functions and types to deal with cell styles

- [XlsxReader.Workbook](https://xlsx-reader.hexdocs.pm/XlsxReader.Workbook.md): 
Workbook structure.
